CREDIT AGREEMENT
RETAIL BORROWER INC. (J.Crew Style Structure)
Dated: June 2024

═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ARTICLE VII - NEGATIVE COVENANTS
═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Section 7.08. Designation of Unrestricted Subsidiaries and Asset Transfers.

(a) Designation. The Borrower may at any time designate any existing Restricted
    Subsidiary as an Unrestricted Subsidiary or form a new Unrestricted Subsidiary.

(b) Asset Transfers. The Borrower may transfer any assets or property to an
    Unrestricted Subsidiary, including, without limitation:
    
    (i) intellectual property (including patents, trademarks, trade names, brands,
        copyrights, and trade secrets);
    
    (ii) real property and equipment;
    
    (iii) inventory and accounts receivable;
    
    (iv) equity interests in Subsidiaries;
    
    (v) any other tangible or intangible assets.

(c) Basket Size. The aggregate fair market value of all designations, investments,
    loans, and asset transfers to Unrestricted Subsidiaries shall not exceed the
    GREATER OF:
    
    (i) $250,000,000; and
    
    (ii) 25% of Consolidated Total Assets at the time of such transaction.

(d) Consent. No consent of any Lender shall be required for any transaction
    contemplated by this Section 7.08, provided that the Borrower delivers a
    certificate from the Chief Financial Officer certifying compliance with the
    basket in clause (c).

(e) Use of Proceeds. There shall be no restriction on the use of assets by an
    Unrestricted Subsidiary, including but not limited to incurrence of debt,
    making restricted payments, or engaging in transactions with Affiliates.

(f) Precedent Transactions. The parties acknowledge that this structure is modeled
    after transactions commonly referred to as "J.Crew" or "Chewy" style dropdowns,
    whereby valuable assets (including the "crown jewels" intellectual property)
    may be transferred outside the restricted group.

CRITICAL LME RISK FACTORS:
• $250M OR 25% of assets basket - MATERIAL SIZE
• IP transfer explicitly permitted - CROWN JEWELS AT RISK
• No lender consent required - UNILATERAL BORROWER ACTION
• No restrictions on Unrestricted Sub activities
• No sweep or mandatory prepayment
• "J.Crew" and "Chewy" precedent language
• LEAKAGE RISK SCORE: 9.5/10.0 (CRITICAL)
